cases.input: Raw lot L is consumed to produce serialized items S1-S10, a blended co-product and scrap.
cases.expect: Inputs, outputs, yield, scrap, units, authority and evidence are captured under one event identity.

cases.input: A validated quantity is later corrected from 99 to 100 units.
cases.expect: The original assertion retains quantity 99, status becomes superseded with supersededByRef set; the successor asserts 100 with supersedesRef, a later recordTime and an unchanged eventTime; no value is overwritten.

cases.input: A routing plan is used as proof that the transformation occurred.
cases.expect: The claim is rejected.

cases.input: The production work order and actual execution share identity.
cases.expect: The identity merge is rejected.

cases.input: Produced output is treated as delivered and accepted.
cases.expect: Both inferences are rejected separately: output creation does not establish delivery and does not establish acceptance; each rejection is emitted with its own code.

cases.input: T consumes 400 kg of L and outputs ten serialized items of 36 kg each, a 30 kg co-product lot and 10 kg scrap.
cases.expect: inputs[0].consumedQuantity 400 kg net; outputs total 360 kg serialized plus 30 kg co-product plus 10 kg scrap; quantityReconciliation.method mass-balance with basis, pinned unit code list and declared tolerance; the reconciliation closes to 400 kg with no unlabelled residual.

cases.input: T consumes 400 kg of a 1000 kg lot L.
cases.expect: inputs[0].consumptionCompleteness partially-consumed with residualAssertedOnLot present; L is neither exhausted nor closed by the event and its residual 600 kg remains traceable.
eventTime and recordTime are both stored with explicit offsets and remain distinct; knowledgeTimeRange.from equals the recordTime; no later status alters eventTime.

cases.input: A recorded transformation is corrected, then the correction is itself corrected.
cases.expect: Three assertions form a bidirectionally resolvable chain: each superseded assertion carries both supersedesRef and supersededByRef, only the newest has status validated, and no assertion is its own successor.

cases.input: A transformation recorded in error is voided with reason wrong-work-centre by the production authority.
cases.expect: status voided with voidRecord carrying voidReason, voidAuthorityRef and recordTime; the prior assertion and its genealogy edges remain readable and are not deleted.

cases.input: A transformation is recorded with inputs and outputs but no yield and no scrap.
cases.expect: The record is refused; yield and scrap are required and may be empty only with a stated reason, never absent.

cases.input: A transformation is recorded with eventTime only.
cases.expect: The record is refused; recordTime is required and is never defaulted from eventTime.

cases.input: A transformation is recorded with a performing agent but no authorityRef.
cases.expect: The record is refused; authority is required on the event and is never inferred from a later status or from the performing agent.

cases.input: An input element states consumedQuantity 400 with no unit and no basis.
cases.expect: The element is refused; every quantity carries unit, basis and scope with a pinned unit code-list version and no unit is inferred.

cases.input: status is set to voided with no voidRecord.
cases.expect: The transition is refused; a void requires reason, authority and record time, and never removes the prior assertion.

cases.input: A WM-ACT-007 maintenance work order is cited as the production authority for T.
cases.expect: The citation is refused; WM-ACT-007 is maintenance-scoped and restricted, and the production-work-order boundary is unallocated.

cases.input: A mass-balance-inferred output edge of a blended co-product is promoted to edgeAssertionClass asserted so it reads as an observed fact.
cases.expect: The promotion is refused; inferred, mass-balance-inferred, stale and incomplete edges retain their class and reason permanently.

cases.input: One expected output of T was never recorded; a yield calculation treats that output as 0.
cases.expect: The calculation is refused; the missing output yields incomplete or indeterminate genealogy and an indeterminate yield, never zero.

cases.input: Consumption of a consignment-stock input lot by T is treated as transferring title of that lot to the producer.
cases.expect: The transfer is refused; consumption changes neither custody nor title and no ownership effect is derived from a transformation.

cases.input: An exposure traversal over T's output edges is emitted as a recall decision for S1..S10.
cases.expect: The emission is refused; traversal yields proven and reason-coded potential sets only, and recall, alert and enforcement authority is external to this contour.

cases.input: T is recorded with an evidenceDigest but no sourceSystem, assertingAgentRef or method.
cases.expect: The record is refused; provenance is required and a digest alone does not establish who asserted the event or how.

cases.input: An assertion is set to status superseded with no supersededByRef.
cases.expect: The transition is refused; supersession requires a resolvable successor reference in both directions.
